Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 5 Ingredients 4 cups 1% or nonfat milk 6 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate (about 3/4 cup) 1 teaspoon vanilla Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Place all ingredients in a blender. Put the lid on tightly. Blend for about 30 seconds or until smooth. Serve and enjoy. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: If you don't have a blender, mix the ingredients well in a bowl until frothy. Add a small banana, a handful of strawberries, or another favorite fruit before blending.
